12:00 PM and 4:00 PM on Saturday and Sunday

Because Highway 1 divides the city into north-side communities (Chilliwack Proper, Downtown, Fairfield Island, Little Mountain, East Chilliwack) and south-side communities (Sardis, Garrison Crossing, Vedder Crossing, Promontory, Yarrow, Cultus Lake), grouping your stops by north side first and south side second saves 20 to 30 minutes of driving across the Vedder Road or Prest Road overpasses.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Open Houses Real Estate FAQs

parts.t: When are open houses usually posted for the upcoming weekend in Chilliwack?

Listing agents typically enter weekend open house times into the MLS® between Wednesday afternoon and Friday morning, and most open houses take place on Saturday and Sunday between 12:00 PM and 4:00 PM.
Do I need to pre-register to attend a public open house in Chilliwack?

No pre-registration is required for public MLS® open houses on this page—you can walk in during the posted hours. However, if you are working with your own buyer's agent, let the host agent know when signing the guest sheet.
What if there are few or no open houses posted early in the week?

Because open house schedules roll over after Sunday afternoon and new times are added mid-week, the list is lighter on Mondays and Tuesdays and fills up by Thursday and Friday. You can browse all active listings anytime on our Chilliwack Homes for Sale page or request a private tour.
Can I book a private showing for a Chilliwack home that isn't holding an open house?

Yes. Most sellers in Chilliwack and Sardis accommodate private buyer showings 7 days a week with 24 hours' notice (and often same-day notice on vacant homes). Call or text 604-928-1361 to arrange a private viewing.
How should I group neighbourhoods when touring Chilliwack open houses?

Start either north of Highway 1 (Downtown Chilliwack Proper, Fairfield Island, Little Mountain) or south of Highway 1 (Sardis, Promontory, Garrison Crossing, Vedder Crossing) so you aren't zig-zagging back and forth across the Highway 1 interchanges during narrow 2-hour open house windows.
What questions should I ask when touring a Promontory or Sardis open house?

Ask whether the land title is freehold or leasehold, check whether any basement suite is registered or unauthorized, ask the age of the roof, furnace, A/C, and hot water tank, and for strata townhomes or condos ask to see the Form B Information Certificate and Depreciation Report.
Can I get automatic email alerts for new Chilliwack listings and open houses?

Yes. Reach out to Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 or jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca with your target neighbourhoods, property type, and price range to receive instant MLS® alerts as soon as new listings or price reductions hit the market.
